title: Number of Community Gardens at HDB Multi-Storey Car Park Rooftops and Implication for Singapore's "30 by 30" Food Security Goal
what_it_is: Number of Community Gardens at HDB Multi-Storey Car Park Rooftops and Implication for Singapore's "30 by 30" Food Security Goal

sections.label: MSCP sites for urban farming
sections.summary: SFA and HDB have tendered 16 MSCP sites for commercial urban farming, and HDB repurposed six MSCP rooftops into community gardens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To date, the Singapore Food Agency (SFA) and HDB have tendered out 16 MSCP sites for commercial urban farming, while HDB has repurposed six MSCP rooftops into community gardens.

sections.label: Evaluating tenders and community gardens
sections.summary: Agencies are evaluating the first two tenders before deciding future plans, while NParks works with others to encourage more community gardens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Agencies are evaluating the outcomes of the first two tenders before deciding on future plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, NParks will continue to work with HDB, Town Councils, Residents' Committees and Neighbourhood Committees to encourage the setting up of more community gardens, including at suitable MSCP rooftop sites or by converting parts of the common green in estates to community gardens.

sections.label: Regulations Workgroup and industry guides
sections.summary: A Regulations Workgroup led by SFA and Enterprise Singapore holds consultation sessions, and guides were launched for farming companies and MSCP rooftop urban farms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For example, there is a Regulations Workgroup, which is led by SFA and Enterprise Singapore, and it conducts multi-agency consultation sessions for the successful tenderers of the rooftop sites for urban farming.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As part of the continuing efforts by the Regulations Workgroup, an industry guide was launched in 2020 last year to provide companies in the farming industry with one consolidated knowledge resource.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: SFA has also worked with HDB and other relevant agencies to prepare a guide, specifically on the setting up of urban farms on HDB MSCP rooftops.

sections.label: HDB carpark electricity supply limits
sections.summary: HDB carparks only come with three-phase 30 amps electricity supply, while high technology farm operators may require three-phase 100 amps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Actually, HDB carparks only come with three-phase 30 amps electricity supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Farm operators, especially for those in high technology farming, may require three-phase 100 amps electricity supply.
